title: Restrict a choice with だけ or しか～ない

variants.label: だけ

segments.role: だけ limits the drink to coffee. This use can accompany an affirmative predicate.

example.translation: In the morning, I drink only coffee.
example.note: The drink is restricted to coffee.

variants.change: だけ limits the drink to coffee. This use can accompany an affirmative predicate.

variants.label: しか～ない

segments.role: しか works with the negative predicate 飲みません in this construction. Together they emphasize excluding other options; the whole sentence still means only coffee.
しか works with the negative predicate 飲みません in this construction. Together they emphasize excluding other options; the whole sentence still means only coffee.

example.translation: In the morning, I drink nothing but coffee.

variants.change: しか works with the negative predicate 飲みません in this construction. Together they emphasize excluding other options; the whole sentence still means only coffee.

question: What does コーヒーしか飲みません mean?
feedback: しか and the negative predicate form a single restrictive construction. Negating the verb alone would give the wrong interpretation.
